definitions: An act of hitting or striking someone or something.
A sudden disabling attack or loss of consciousness caused by an interruption in the flow of blood to the brain.
A movement of a pen or brush when drawing or writing.
A single complete movement of an arm or oar in rowing or swimming.
A gentle touch or caress with the hand.
examples: He received a severe stroke on the head.
She had a stroke and lost the ability to speak.
The artist's bold strokes defined the landscape.
He took a powerful stroke and pulled ahead.
She gave the cat a gentle stroke.
